newsitem.title: FRANCE: Renault falls as analysts cut forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Renault falls as analysts cut forecasts.

text.p: Renault SA shares were down sharply at mid-day but off their lows after analysts cut their full-year earnings forecasts following Tuesday's announcement by the carmaker that first half profits tumbled.
Among those lowering their forecasts was Lehman Brothers which said it reduced its 1996 earnings per share estimate to a loss of one franc from a profit of three francs.
"The company is more or less saying to people, 'We are going to lose money this year'," said Lehman analyst Christopher Will.
At 0948 GMT, Renault shares were down 8.0 francs, or more than five percent, at 111.70 francs on 304,764 shares traded.
